resources.string: Allows this app to send text and images to the on-device AI model for summarising, rewriting and similar tasks. Nothing leaves the device.
Runs a language model locally. Nothing is sent off the device and no usage data is collected.

A language model runs entirely on this phone. Prompts and results never leave the device, are never written to disk or logs, and no usage data is collected.

The model is a large download and is not included in the ROM. You will be shown its licence terms before anything is fetched.

Running it uses noticeable battery and can warm the device. You can turn this off, or remove the model entirely, at any time.
